title: Killer College Scandal
overview: Martha's life changes forever when her kind-hearted son, Josh, dies suddenly during his freshman year of college after an apparent hazing gone wrong. Her grief turns to shock when Josh's girlfriend, Ashley, drops a bombshell on Martha: she's pregnant, Josh is the father, and Josh's death is no accident... it was cold-blooded murder. Martha and Ashley team up together in search of the truth, and in the process they unearth a web of deadly deceit and sinister secrets, all leading to the highest echelons of a top-secret fraternity that will stop short of nothing to defend its members... not even murder.
